messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: p99 latency spike detected for /v1/stream endpoint (hosted). Auto-alert triggered. Initial telemetry: p95 -> 1.2s (ok), p99 -> 12.7s (breach). Checked synthetic monitors, customer-facing errors increasing. Paging oncall.
oncall-maya: I'm on it. pinging SRE and runtime. Can someone grab traces and proxy logs?
sre-liam: grabbing traces now. early signal shows long tail on chunk flush, heavy backpressure from a subset of clients. streaming_write_latency p99 spiked to 9-13s across ae-us-west region.
eng-amy: adding proxy proxy-frontend-usw-2 logs, seeing repeated 504 from proxy -> backend keepalive timeouts around the same window. snippet:``` 
[proxy] 2026-03-15T01:02:34Z upstream_timeout backend=10.0.12.45:8080 path=/v1/stream chunk_write_timeout=12000ms
[proxy] 2026-03-15T01:02:35Z connection_reset by peer
```
infra-oliver: checking host metrics — networking looks saturated on a few proxy nodes. socket backlog growing, tcp_retries rising. Also kernel SO_SNDBUF saturating.
pm-raj: any known deploys or config changes in the last hour? Customer-impacting?
eng-amy: no infra deploys. small config tweak in batching yesterday but not in prod region. runtime orthogonal.
cs-jen: reported by two customers (payments-app and chatflow) — they saw chat hangs and timeouts, some users reported incomplete streams. They are on US-West. Asking for ETA.
onscall-maya: immediate mitigation idea: 1) route traffic away from affected proxy nodes, 2) increase proxy keepalive and timeouts temporarily, 3) enable conservative fallback to chunked non-streaming responses for affected routes. Which can we do fast?
sre-liam: I can detraffic nodes by toggling LB weights. doing that now. Will also enable proxy connection pool drain on the bad hosts.
eng-amy: fallback change needs a small feature flag flip in routing layer — can enable at edge for /v1/stream to return chunked (non-SSE) in case of sustained slow clients. I can prepare a safe flip (no restart).
infra-oliver: bumping net.core.wmem_max and SO_SNDBUF on impacted proxies gives quick breathing room. applying to canary group then roll.
cs-jen: sharing customer messages: "streams freeze mid-response, clients need manual reconnect" — flagged as P2+impact for now.
pm-raj: please document customer-facing mitigation and ETA so CS can update SLAs.
sre-liam: quick diagnostics: running flame trace on runtime, but early kernel-level TCP stats show long slow consumers causing write backpressure. Candidates: mobile clients with poor networks + certain proxies accumulating outstanding writes.
eng-amy: here's a small check command for anyone troubleshooting:``` 
# check long-lived connections and per-socket send-q
ss -o state established '( dport = :http or sport = :http )' | awk '{print $1,$2,$3,$4}'
# tail proxy logs
kubectl -n proxy logs -l app=proxy -c envoy --since=10m | grep upstream_timeout
```
sre-liam: routing change applied: 3 proxy nodes drained and weight set to 0. traffic shifted off them. observing p99 starting to fall in the last minute (was 12.7s -> 5.6s).
onscall-maya: good. record temporary config change: proxy.keepalive_ms = 30000 -> 60000 for region.
infra-oliver: keepalive bumped on canary proxies. also increased SO_SNDBUF on those hosts to 4MB. planning a gradual roll.
eng-amy: enabling chunked-fallback flag for edge for customers on US-West — flip in 30s. will log the change id.
cs-jen: informing customers: "We are aware of streaming stalls in US-West. We've redirected traffic and applied mitigations; some users may see temporary non-SSE chunked responses while we stabilize. Expect updates in 15 minutes" 
pm-raj: good messaging. include reason (slow consumers causing proxy backpressure).
sre-liam: live metrics: p99 now 3.2s, p95 steady at 0.9s, error rate down 60%. trending better.
eng-amy: observed some clients reconnect spam after fallback flip — rate limiter engaged. tweaking client-side reconnect backoff guidance in docs.
incident-bot: Incident annotated: latency_spike_streaming/1795550123 severity=high region=us-west mitigation=traffic_shift+proxy_tweaks+fallback_chunked status=mitigating
onscall-maya: next steps for handoff: 1) continue rolling proxy keepalive+buffers across region (infra), 2) monitor p99 and errors for 30m, 3) eng to validate no regression from fallback, 4) SRE to run root-cause correlation on client IPs and user agents.
sre-liam: starting log correlation job now, pulling client IPs with long-lived write queues.
infra-oliver: rolling sysctl to remaining proxies (10 nodes) — will do 2 at a time. ETA 20m.
eng-amy: will run a targeted canary to revert fallback for low-risk customers in 40m if metrics stable.
cs-jen: customers updated. no escalations to legal/enterprise yet. two customers asked for an RCA window — we'll prepare postmortem.
pm-raj: assign owner for postmortem?
sre-liam: I'll own the RCA. eng-amy to co-author with network findings.
onscall-maya: handing off to night oncall. please use this thread for updates. If p99 climbs again >8s, page immediately. :phone:
onscall-maya: Handoff summary (pasteable): "Oncall Maya -> Night oncall: streaming p99 spike in us-west due to slow clients/backpressure on proxy nodes. Traffic shifted, proxy keepalive and socket buffers increased, chunked-fallback enabled. Monitor p99 and error-rate; infra rolling sysctl to remaining nodes. SRE (Liam) owning RCA; Eng (Amy) on fallback revert plan." 
pm-raj: add request to include customer list and timestamps to RCA.
sre-liam: noted. starting correlation job results: top 10 client IPs account for 45% of slow connections, user-agent pattern looks like legacy mobile SDK v1.2. Suggest outreach to those customers + runtime mitigation for aggressive slow-consumer detection.
cs-jen: collecting customer contact list now.
onscall-maya: thanks everyone. leaving thread in monitoring mode. :white_check_mark:
eng-amy: logged change IDs: fallback_flag=chg-8241, sysctl_roll=chg-8242.
incident-bot: update: mitigation status=partial; watch for 30m.
sre-liam: if everything stable by +30m, we'll close with postmortem draft. otherwise escalate to SEV-1.
cs-jen: created ticket CS-1129 to track customer comms.
onscall-maya: end handoff.
